points.title: 早年教育
points.description: 赫伯特·斯宾塞出生于英格兰德比的一个非国教派家庭，父亲是学校教师。由于健康状况不佳，斯宾塞接受的是家庭教育，很少进入正规学校。他自学了数学、科学和哲学，并对进化思想产生了浓厚兴趣。这段自学经历培养了他独立思考的能力，也使他形成了对传统教育体系的批判态度。德比时期的经历奠定了他后来思想体系的基础，特别是对科学方法和进化论的推崇。
points.descriptionEn: Herbert Spencer was born in Derby, England, to a nonconformist family. Due to poor health, he received home education rather than attending formal schools. He self-studied mathematics, science, and philosophy, developing a keen interest in evolutionary thought. This period of self-education fostered his independent thinking abilities and shaped his critical attitude toward traditional education systems. His Derby experiences laid the foundation for his later philosophical system, particularly his emphasis on scientific methods and evolutionary theory.

points.title: 铁路工程师与记者
points.description: 斯宾塞移居伦敦，最初担任铁路工程师，参与铁路建设工作。这段经历让他接触到工程学和社会组织问题，开始思考社会结构与机械系统的相似性。1848年，他成为《经济学家》杂志的副编辑，开始撰写关于政治、哲学和社会问题的文章。在这一时期，他逐渐形成了自己的社会进化思想，开始撰写《社会静力学》，这是他系统阐述社会进化理论的第一部重要著作。伦敦的经历使他接触到当时最前沿的科学思想和社会变革，为他后来的理论体系提供了实践基础。
points.descriptionEn: Spencer moved to London and initially worked as a railway engineer, participating in railway construction. This experience exposed him to engineering principles and organizational problems, leading him to consider similarities between social structures and mechanical systems. In 1848, he became an assistant editor of The Economist, beginning to write articles on politics, philosophy, and social issues. During this period, he developed his social evolutionary ideas and began writing 'Social Statics,' his first major work systematically presenting his theory of social evolution. His London experiences exposed him to cutting-edge scientific thought and social changes, providing practical foundations for his later theoretical system.

points.title: 哲学体系构建
points.description: 这一时期是斯宾塞思想体系形成的关键阶段。1851年，他出版了《社会静力学》，提出了著名的'适者生存'概念，比达尔文更早使用这一术语。1852年，他发表了《进步：其规律和原因》，将进化思想应用于社会领域。1855年，他开始撰写《综合哲学》系列著作，试图将所有知识统一在一个进化框架下。这一时期，斯宾塞的思想逐渐从激进自由主义转向更为保守的立场，强调个人自由与自然选择的结合。伦敦的知识环境使他能够与当时的思想家交流，但他的理论也开始引发争议，特别是关于社会达尔文主义的观点。
points.descriptionEn: This period was crucial for the formation of Spencer's philosophical system. In 1851, he published 'Social Statics,' introducing the famous concept of 'survival of the fittest,' predating Darwin's use of the term. In 1852, he published 'Progress: Its Law and Cause,' applying evolutionary thinking to social phenomena. Starting in 1855, he began writing his 'System of Synthetic Philosophy,' attempting to unify all knowledge within an evolutionary framework. During this time, Spencer's thinking shifted from radical liberalism to a more conservative stance, emphasizing the combination of individual freedom with natural selection. London's intellectual environment allowed him to engage with contemporary thinkers, but his theories began to generate controversy, particularly regarding his social Darwinist views.

points.title: 综合哲学体系完成
points.description: 这是斯宾塞学术生涯的巅峰时期。他完成了《综合哲学》系列的主要著作，包括《第一原理》(1862)、《生物学原理》(1864-1867)、《心理学原理》(1870-1872)、《社会学原理》(1876-1896)和《伦理学原理》(1879-1893)。这一时期，斯宾塞的理论体系达到顶峰，他被誉为'达尔文的先知'和'社会达尔文主义之父'。他的思想影响广泛，不仅限于学术界，还渗透到政治、教育和商业领域。然而，随着达尔文进化论的普及，斯宾塞的'适者生存'概念被用于支持各种社会政策，包括自由放任资本主义和帝国主义，这使他成为争议人物。伦敦作为知识中心，为他的理论传播提供了平台，但也使他的思想面临更多批判。
points.descriptionEn: This period marked the peak of Spencer's academic career. He completed the major works of his 'System of Synthetic Philosophy,' including 'First Principles' (1862), 'Principles of Biology' (1864-1867), 'Principles of Psychology' (1870-1872), 'Principles of Sociology' (1876-1896), and 'Principles of Ethics' (1879-1893). During this time, Spencer's theoretical system reached its zenith, earning him the titles 'prophet of Darwin' and 'father of social Darwinism.' His ideas had widespread influence, extending beyond academia into politics, education, and business. However, as Darwin's theory of evolution gained popularity, Spencer's concept of 'survival of the fittest' was applied to support various social policies, including laissez-faire capitalism and imperialism, making him a controversial figure. London, as a center of knowledge, provided a platform for the dissemination of his theories but also exposed his ideas to greater criticism.

points.title: 晚年隐居与影响
points.description: 晚年，斯宾塞因健康问题逐渐从公众视野中隐退，移居布莱顿。尽管身体虚弱，他仍在继续修订和完善他的著作。这一时期，他的理论开始受到更多质疑，特别是随着社会改革思想的兴起。然而，他的思想仍然影响着全球范围内的知识分子和政治家。1902年，斯宾塞被提名诺贝尔文学奖候选，但未获奖。1903年，他在布莱顿逝世，享年83岁。斯宾塞的晚年虽然远离学术中心，但他的思想遗产继续影响着20世纪的社会科学和公共政策。他的理论虽然受到批评，但'适者生存'等概念已成为现代语言和文化的重要组成部分。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Spencer gradually withdrew from public view due to health issues and moved to Brighton. Despite his declining health, he continued to revise and expand his works. During this period, his theories faced increasing criticism, particularly with the rise of social reform movements. Nevertheless, his ideas continued to influence intellectuals and politicians worldwide. In 1902, Spencer was nominated for the Nobel Prize in Literature but did not win. He died in Brighton in 1903 at the age of 83. Though his later years were spent away from academic centers, his intellectual legacy continued to influence 20th-century social science and public policy. While his theories were criticized, concepts like 'survival of the fittest' became integral parts of modern language and culture.

supporter.zh: 斯宾塞被誉为19世纪最重要的社会思想家之一，他的综合哲学体系首次尝试将科学方法应用于社会科学，为现代社会学奠定了基础。他提出的'适者生存'概念虽然常被误解，但原意是描述自然选择过程，而非鼓吹残酷竞争。斯宾塞强调个人自由与有限政府，他的思想影响了自由主义传统，特别是对政府干预的警惕。他的进化论框架为理解社会变迁提供了新视角，促进了社会科学的学科化发展。
supporter.en: Spencer is regarded as one of the most important social thinkers of the 19th century. His synthetic philosophy was the first major attempt to apply scientific methods to social sciences, laying the foundation for modern sociology. His concept of 'survival of the fittest,' though often misunderstood, was originally intended to describe natural selection rather than advocate ruthless competition. Spencer emphasized individual liberty and limited government, influencing liberal traditions, particularly regarding skepticism toward government intervention. His evolutionary framework provided new perspectives for understanding social change, promoting the professional development of social sciences.

critic.zh: 斯宾塞的理论受到多方面批评。首先，他的社会达尔文主义被用于为不平等和社会不公正辩护，包括种族主义和帝国主义政策。其次，他的'适者生存'概念被简化为对弱者的无情淘汰，忽视了社会合作和道德因素。第三，他的理论过度依赖机械类比，将社会简化为生物有机体，忽视了人类社会的复杂性和文化因素。最后，他的政治立场从激进自由主义转向保守主义，被批评为放弃了社会改革的责任，为现状辩护。
critic.en: Spencer's theories have faced numerous criticisms. First, his social Darwinism was used to justify inequality and social injustice, including racist and imperialist policies. Second, his concept of 'survival of the fittest' was simplified into ruthless elimination of the weak, ignoring social cooperation and moral factors. Third, his theory relied excessively on mechanical analogies, reducing society to a biological organism while neglecting the complexity and cultural aspects of human societies. Finally, his political shift from radical liberalism to conservatism was criticized as abandoning responsibility for social reform and defending the status quo.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，斯宾塞被视为连接达尔文进化论与社会思想的关键人物。他的理论虽然存在争议，但促进了社会科学的学科化发展。斯宾塞的思想遗产复杂而矛盾：一方面，他推动了科学方法在社会研究中的应用；另一方面，他的理论被用于支持有害的社会政策。在现代语境中，斯宾塞常被简化为'社会达尔文主义之父'，而忽视了他思想中的其他重要方面，如对个人自由的强调和对政府干预的批判。他的影响力超越了学术界，成为现代语言和文化中'适者生存'等概念的来源。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Spencer is viewed as a key figure connecting Darwin's theory of evolution with social thought. While controversial, his work contributed to the professionalization of social sciences. Spencer's intellectual legacy is complex and contradictory: on one hand, he promoted the application of scientific methods to social research; on the other, his theories were used to support harmful social policies. In modern contexts, Spencer is often simplified as the 'father of social Darwinism,' while overlooking other important aspects of his thought, such as his emphasis on individual liberty and critique of government intervention. His influence extends beyond academia, making him the source of concepts like 'survival of the fittest' in modern language and culture.

self.zh: 进化是宇宙的普遍规律，从星云的形成到人类社会的进步，无一不在遵循这一法则。
self.en: Evolution is a universal law, from the formation of nebulae to the progress of human society, all follow this law.

others.zh: 斯宾塞是一位伟大的体系构建者，但他的体系就像一座宏伟但摇摇欲坠的建筑，每一块砖石都经过精心挑选，但整体结构却缺乏坚实的基础。
others.en: Spencer was a great system-builder, but his system is like a magnificent yet precarious edifice, where every stone has been carefully selected, but the whole structure lacks a solid foundation.
